These eleven unchanged sources are the Android 13 `JSONObject`/`JSONStringer`
implementation and its JSON streaming reader from `android-13.0.0_r1`.
`source-manifest.json` records every original URL, byte count and SHA-256.
Original Apache 2.0 notices remain intact. Only unavailable annotation types
have test-only declarations under `support`; no JSON behavior is substituted.

The host harness compiles the actual production Java receipt inspector and
the shared Python receipt codec against these sources. Real production Python
coordinators generate its receipts; only native extractors and shader compiler
execution are replaced with tiny synthetic structural output. The old Android
slash-escaping policy is separately tested as a regression mutant. This is not
Android execution, owner-data conversion, Thor readiness or gameplay evidence.
The disposable Android instrumentation tests exercise the platform's actual
JSON implementation again with the same independently produced Python assets.
